value.rationale: The recent sharp theta-convolution Brunn-Minkowski work explicitly leaves the low-theta simplex-optimality boundary unknown. This theorem determines a natural exact ball-versus-simplex obstruction in every dimension, proves it strictly improves the source’s ball obstruction (not just numerically), and extracts a sharp \(n^{-7/30}\) prefactor relevant to the high-dimensional gap. For \(n=2\) the published ball test threshold in \(s=\theta^{1/2}\) improves from 0.2 to about 0.41078749. It is not a routine renaming, known table recomputation or unsupported general-optimality assertion.
